import datetime

offsets = {
    "UTC-4 (EDT)": -4,
    "UTC-5 (EST/CDT)": -5,
    "UTC-6 (CST/MDT)": -6,
    "UTC-7 (MST/PDT)": -7,
    "UTC-8 (PST)": -8,
    "UTC+5 (PKT)": 5,
    "UTC+5:30 (IST)": 5.5,
}
print()
for label, off in offsets.items():
    tz = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=off))
